auto_context.card: This is an archived live stream uploaded on May 31, 2026, from the hololive VTuber Momosuzu Nene (桃鈴ねね) on her channel Nene Ch.桃鈴ねね. The stream is a casual, fan-oriented variety segment called ねぽらぼ (Neporaabo), a recurring collab unit featuring Nene alongside fellow hololive members Omaru Polka (尾丸ポルカ), Yukihana Lamy (雪花ラミィ), and Shishiro Botan (獅白ぼたん), though the tags suggest Nene may be the primary or sole on-screen participant here. The main content is a tier-list discussion — done in a subjective, humorous tone — ranking hololive members by who Nene would want as a little sister (ホロメン妹にするなら), with many hololive member names appearing as proper nouns throughout. The stream also includes a major announcement (重大告知), which from the description relates to Nene's 1st solo live concert "花咲く＊ねねねねねねねね超開花！" scheduled for July 29, 2026 at Tokyo Garden Theater, as well as her 1st album "Peachful Story" releasing July 8, 2026. The register is casual and energetic, typical of hololive entertainment streams.
